en.answer: <<13010>> is a Special Summon-only monster, so it must first be Special Summoned by the method written in its text. In this scenario, if there are 4 Dinosaur-Type monsters in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 2 copies of <<13010>> from your hand during the same turn.
en.question: If I have 2 copies of <<13010>> in my hand, can I Special Summon both of them with their own procedure during the same turn?
